ayahs.1: Taa Seen, yeh aayaten hain Quran ki (yaani waazeh) aur roshan kitaab ki.
ayahs.2: Hidayat aur khushkhabri imaan walon ke liye.
ayahs.3: Jo namaz qaaim karte hain aur zakaat ada karte hain aur aakhirat par yaqeen rakhte hain.
ayahs.4: Jo log qayamat par imaan nahin laate hum ne unhein un ke kartoot zeenat-daar kar dikhaaye hain, pas woh bhatakte phirte hain.
ayahs.5: Yehi log hain jin ke liye bura azaab hai aur aakhirat mein bhi woh sakht nuqsaan-yaafta hain.
ayahs.6: Beshak aap ko Allah hakeem-o-aleem ki taraf se Quran sikhaaya ja raha hai.
ayahs.7: (Yaad hoga) jabke Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne apne ghar walon se kaha ke main ne aag dekhi hai, main wahan se ya to koi khabar le kar ya aag ka koi sulagta hua angaara le kar abhi tumhare paas aa jaaoon ga taake tum senk-taap kar lo.
ayahs.8: Jab wahan pahunche to aawaaz di gayi ke ba-barkat hai woh jo is aag mein hai aur barkat diya gaya hai woh jis ke aas paas hai aur paak hai Allah jo tamaam jahaanon ka paalne wala hai.
ayahs.9: Moosa! Sun baat yeh hai ke main hi Allah hoon ghaalib ba-hikmat.
ayahs.10: To apni laathi daal de, Moosa ne jab use hilta-julta dekha is tarah ke goya woh ek saanp hai to munh mode hue peeth pher kar bhaage aur palat kar bhi na dekha, aye Moosa! Khauf na kha, mere huzoor mein Paighambar dara nahin karte.
ayahs.11: Lekin jo log zulm karen phir is ke iwaz neki karen is buraai ke peechhe to main bhi bakhshne wala mehrbaan hoon.
ayahs.12: Aur apna haath apne garebaan mein daal, woh safed chamkeela ho kar niklega baghair kisi aib ke, to nau nishaaniyan le kar Firaun aur us ki qaum ki taraf ja, yaqeenan woh badkaaron ka giroh hai.
ayahs.13: Pas jab un ke paas aankhen khol dene wale hamare mojize pahunche to woh kehne lage yeh to sareeh jaadu hai.
ayahs.14: Unhon ne inkaar kar diya halaanke un ke dil yaqeen kar chuke the sirf zulm aur takabbur ki bina par. Pas dekh lijiye ke in fitna-pardaaz logon ka anjaam kaisa kuchh hua.
ayahs.15: Aur hum ne yaqeenan Daaood aur Sulaiman ko ilm de rakha tha. Aur donon ne kaha, tareef is Allah ke liye hai jis ne hamein apne bahut se imaan-daar bandon par fazeelat ata farmaayi hai.
ayahs.16: Aur Daaood ke waaris Sulaiman hue aur kehne lage logo! Hamein parindon ki boli sikhaayi gayi hai aur hum sab kuchh mein se diye gaye hain. Beshak yeh bilkul khula hua fazl-e-Ilahi hai.
ayahs.17: Sulaiman ke saamne un ke tamaam lashkar jinnat aur insan aur parind mein se jama kiye gaye (har har qism ki) alag alag darja-bandi kar di gayi.
ayahs.18: Jab woh cheentiyon ke maidan mein pahunche to ek cheenti ne kaha aye cheentiyo! Apne apne gharon mein ghus jaao, aisa na ho ke be-khabari mein Sulaiman aur us ka lashkar tumhein raund daale.
ayahs.19: Us ki is baat se Hazrat Sulaiman muskura kar hans diye aur dua karne lage ke aye Parwardigar! Tu mujhe taufeeq de ke main teri in ne'maton ka shukr baja laaoon jo tu ne mujh par in'aam ki hain aur mere maan baap par aur main aise nek aamaal karta rahoon jin se tu khush rahe mujhe apni rahmat se nek bandon mein shaamil kar le.
ayahs.20: Aap ne parindon ki dekh-bhaal ki aur farmaane lage yeh kya baat hai ke main hud-hud ko nahin dekhta? Kya waaqai woh ghair haazir hai?
ayahs.21: Yaqeenan main use sakht saza doon ga, ya use zibah kar daaloon ga, ya mere saamne koi sareeh daleel bayan kare.
ayahs.22: Kuchh ziyaada der na guzri thi ke aa kar us ne kaha main ek aisi cheez ki khabar laaya hoon ke tujhe us ki khabar hi nahin, main Saba ki ek sachchi khabar tere paas laaya hoon.
ayahs.23: Main ne dekha ke un ki baadshaahat ek aurat kar rahi hai jise har qism ki cheez se kuchh na kuchh diya gaya hai aur us ka takht bhi badi azmat wala hai.
ayahs.24: Main ne use aur us ki qaum ko, Allah Taala ko chhod kar sooraj ko sajda karte hue paaya, shaytaan ne un ke kaam unhein bhale kar ke dikhla kar saheeh raah se rok diya hai. Pas woh hidayat par nahin aate.
ayahs.25: Ke isi Allah ke liye sajde karen jo aasmanon aur zameenon ke posheeda cheezon ko baahar nikaalta hai, aur jo kuchh tum chhupaate ho aur zaahir karte ho woh sab kuchh jaanta hai.
ayahs.26: Is ke siwa koi mabood-e-bar-haq nahin wahi azmat wale arsh ka maalik hai.
ayahs.27: Sulaiman ne kaha, ab hum dekhenge ke tu ne sach kaha hai ya tu jhoota hai.
ayahs.28: Mere is khat ko le ja kar unhein de de phir un ke paas se hat aa aur dekh ke woh kya jawab dete hain.
ayahs.29: Woh kehne lagi aye sardaro! Meri taraf ek ba-waqar khat daala gaya hai.
ayahs.30: Jo Sulaiman ki taraf se hai aur jo bakhshish karne wale mehrbaan Allah ke naam se shuroo hai.
ayahs.31: Yeh ke tum mere saamne sarkashi na karo aur musalman ban kar mere paas aa jaao.
ayahs.32: Us ne kaha aye mere sardaro! Tum mere is muamle mein mujhe mashwara do. Main kisi amr ka qatai faisla jab tak tumhari maujoodgi aur raaye na ho nahin kiya karti.
ayahs.33: Un sab ne jawab diya ke hum taaqat aur quwwat wale sakht ladne-bhidne wale hain. Aage aap ko ikhtiyaar hai aap khud hi soch lijiye ke hamein aap kya kuchh hukm farmaati hain.
ayahs.34: Us ne kaha ke baadshaah jab kisi basti mein ghuste hain to use ujaad dete hain aur wahan ke ba-izzat logon ko zaleel kar dete hain aur yeh log bhi aisa hi karenge.
ayahs.35: Main unhein ek hadiya bhejne wali hoon, phir dekh loon gi ke qaasid kya jawab le kar lautte hain.
ayahs.36: Pas jab qaasid Hazrat Sulaiman ke paas pahuncha to aap ne farmaaya kya tum maal se mujhe madad dena chaahte ho? Mujhe to mere Rabb ne is se bahut behtar de rakha hai jo us ne tumhein diya hai pas tum hi apne tohfe se khush raho.
ayahs.37: Ja un ki taraf waapas laut ja, hum in (ke muqaable) par woh lashkar laayenge jin ke saamne padne ki in mein taaqat nahin aur hum unhein zaleel-o-past kar ke wahan se nikaal baahar karenge.
ayahs.38: Aap ne farmaaya aye sardaro! Tum mein se koi hai jo un ke musalman ho kar pahunchne se pehle hi us ka takht mujhe la de.
ayahs.39: Ek qawi-haikal jinn kehne laga aap apni is majlis se uthen is se pehle hi pehle main ise aap ke paas la deta hoon, yaqeen maaniye ke main is par qaadir hoon aur hoon bhi amaanat-daar.
ayahs.40: Jis ke paas kitaab ka ilm tha woh bol utha ke aap palak jhapkaayen is se bhi pehle main ise aap ke paas pahuncha sakta hoon. Jab aap ne ise apne paas maujood paaya to farmaane lage yehi mere Rabb ka fazl hai, taake woh mujhe aazmaaye ke main shukr-guzaari karta hoon ya na-shukri, shukr-guzaar apne hi nafa ke liye shukr-guzaari karta hai aur jo na-shukri kare to mera Parwardigar (be-parwa aur buzurg) ghani aur kareem hai.
ayahs.41: Hukm diya ke is ke takht mein kuchh pher-badal kar do taake maloom ho jaaye ke yeh raah paa leti hai ya un mein se hoti hai jo raah nahin paate.
ayahs.42: Phir jab woh aa gayi to us se kaha (daryaaft kiya) gaya ke aisa hi tera (bhi) takht hai? Us ne jawab diya ke yeh goya wohi hai, hamein is se pehle hi ilm diya gaya tha aur hum musalman the.
ayahs.43: Use unhon ne rok rakha tha jin ki woh Allah ke siwa parastish karti rahi thi, yaqeenan woh kaafir logon mein se thi.
ayahs.44: Us se kaha gaya ke mahal mein chali chalo, jise dekh kar yeh samajh kar ke yeh hauz hai us ne apni pindliyan khol din, farmaaya yeh to sheeshe se mandhi hui imaarat hai, kehne lagi mere Parwardigar! Main ne apne aap par zulm kiya. Ab main Sulaiman ke saath Allah Rabbul-Aalameen ki mutee aur farmaanbardaar banti hoon.
ayahs.45: Yaqeenan hum ne Samood ki taraf un ke bhai Saaleh ko bheja ke tum sab Allah ki ibaadat karo phir bhi woh do fareeq ban kar aapas mein ladne-jhagadne lage.
ayahs.46: Aap ne farmaaya aye meri qaum ke logo! Tum neki se pehle buraai ki jaldi kyun macha rahe ho? Tum Allah Taala se istighfaar kyun nahin karte taake tum par rahm kiya jaaye.
ayahs.47: Woh kehne lage hum to teri aur tere saathiyon ki bad-shugooni le rahe hain? Aap ne farmaaya tumhari bad-shugooni Allah ke haan hai, balke tum fitne mein pade hue log ho.
ayahs.48: Is shehar mein nau sardar the jo zameen mein fasaad phailaate rehte the aur islaah nahin karte the.
ayahs.49: Unhon ne aapas mein badi qasmen kha kha kar ahd kiya ke raat hi ko Saaleh aur us ke ghar walon par hum chhaapa maarenge, aur us ke waarison se saaf keh denge ke hum us ke ahl ki halaakat ke waqt maujood na the aur hum bilkul sachche hain.
ayahs.50: Unhon ne makr (khufiya tadbeer) kiya aur hum ne bhi aur woh ise samajhte hi na the.
ayahs.51: (Ab) dekh le un ke makr ka anjaam kaisa kuchh hua? Ke hum ne un ko aur un ki qaum ko sab ko ghaarat kar diya.
ayahs.52: Yeh hain un ke makanaat jo un ke zulm ki wajah se ujde pade hain, jo log ilm rakhte hain un ke liye is mein badi nishani hai.
ayahs.53: Hum ne un ko jo imaan laaye the aur parhezgaar the baal baal bacha liya.
ayahs.54: Aur Loot ka (zikr kar) jabke us ne apni qaum se kaha ke kya ba-wujood dekhne-bhaalne ke phir bhi tum badkaari kar rahe ho?
ayahs.55: Yeh kya baat hai ke tum auraton ko chhod kar mardon ke paas shahwat se aate ho haq yeh hai ke tum badi hi naadaani kar rahe ho.
ayahs.56: Qaum ka jawab bajuz is kehne ke aur kuchh na tha ke aal-e-Loot ko apne shehar se shehar-badar kar do, yeh to bade paak-baaz ban rahe hain.
ayahs.57: Pas hum ne use aur us ke ahl ko bajuz us ki biwi ke sab ko bacha liya, us ka andaaza to baaqi reh jaane walon mein hum laga hi chuke the.
ayahs.58: Aur un par ek (khaas qism) ki baarish barsa di, pas in dhamkaaye hue logon par buri baarish hui.
ayahs.59: To keh de ke tamaam tareef Allah hi ke liye hai aur us ke barguzida bandon par salaam hai. Kya Allah Taala behtar hai ya woh jinhein yeh log shareek thehra rahe hain.
ayahs.60: Bhala bataao to? Ke aasmanon ko aur zameen ko kis ne paida kiya? Kis ne aasman se baarish barsaayi? Phir is se hare bhare ba-raunaq baaghaat uga diye? In baaghon ke darakhton ko tum har-giz na uga sakte, kya Allah ke saath aur koi mabood bhi hai? Balke yeh log hat jaate hain (seedhi raah se).
ayahs.61: Kya woh jis ne zameen ko qaraargaah banaaya aur is ke darmiyaan nehren jaari kar din aur is ke liye pahaad banaaye aur do samundaron ke darmiyaan rok bana di kya Allah ke saath aur koi mabood bhi hai? Balke in mein se aksar kuchh jaante hi nahin.
ayahs.62: Be-kas ki pukaar ko jabke woh pukaare, kaun qubool kar ke sakhti ko door kar deta hai? Aur tumhein zameen ka khalifa banaata hai, kya Allah Taala ke saath aur mabood hai? Tum bahut kam naseehat-o-ibrat haasil karte ho.
ayahs.63: Kya woh jo tumhein khushki aur tari ki taareekiyon mein raah dikhaata hai aur jo apni rahmat se pehle hi khushkhabriyan dene wali hawaayen chalaata hai, kya Allah ke saath koi aur mabood bhi hai jinhein yeh shareek karte hain in sab se Allah buland-o-baala-tar hai.
ayahs.64: Kya woh jo makhlooq ki awwal dafa paidaish karta hai phir use lautaayega aur jo tumhein aasman aur zameen se roziyan de raha hai, kya Allah ke saath koi aur mabood hai keh dijiye ke agar sachche ho to apni daleel laao.
ayahs.65: Keh dijiye ke aasmanon walon mein se zameen walon mein se siwaaye Allah ke koi ghaib nahin jaanta, unhein to yeh bhi nahin maloom ke kab utha khade kiye jaayenge?
ayahs.66: Balke aakhirat ke baare mein un ka ilm khatm ho chuka hai, balke yeh us ki taraf se shak mein hain. Balke yeh us se andhe hain.
ayahs.67: Kaafiron ne kaha ke kya jab hum mitti ho jaayenge aur hamare baap dada bhi kya hum phir nikaale jaayenge.
ayahs.68: Hum aur hamare baap dadon ko bahut pehle se yeh waade diye jaate rahe. Kuchh nahin yeh to sirf aglon ke afsaane hain.
ayahs.69: Keh dijiye ke zameen mein chal phir kar zara dekho to sahi ke gunahgaaron ka kaisa anjaam hua?
ayahs.70: Aap un ke baare mein gham na karen aur un ke daaon-ghaat se tang-dil na hon.
ayahs.71: Kehte hain ke yeh wada kab hai agar sachche ho to batla do.
ayahs.72: Jawab dijiye! Ke shaayad baaz woh cheezen jin ki tum jaldi macha rahe ho tum se bahut hi qareeb ho gayi hon.
ayahs.73: Yaqeenan aap ka Parwardigar tamaam logon par bade hi fazl wala hai lekin aksar log na-shukri karte hain.
ayahs.74: Beshak aap ka Rabb in cheezon ko bhi jaanta hai jinhein un ke seene chhupa rahe hain aur jinhein zaahir kar rahe hain.
ayahs.75: Aasman-o-zameen ki koi posheeda cheez bhi aisi nahin jo roshan aur khuli kitaab mein na ho.
ayahs.76: Yaqeenan yeh Quran Bani Israeel ke saamne in aksar cheezon ka bayan kar raha hai jin mein yeh ikhtilaaf karte hain.
ayahs.77: Aur yeh Quran imaan walon ke liye yaqeenan hidayat aur rahmat hai.
ayahs.78: Aap ka Rabb un ke darmiyaan apne hukm se sab faisle kar dega, woh bada hi ghaalib aur daana hai.
ayahs.79: Pas aap yaqeenan Allah hi par bharosa rakhiye, yaqeenan aap sachche aur khule deen par hain.
ayahs.80: Beshak aap na murdon ko suna sakte hain aur na behron ko apni pukaar suna sakte hain, jabke woh peeth phere roogardaan ja rahe hon.
ayahs.81: Aur na aap andhon ko un ki gumraahi se hata kar rehnumaai kar sakte hain aap to sirf unhein suna sakte hain jo hamari aayaton par imaan laaye hain phir woh farmaanbardaar ho jaate hain.
ayahs.82: Jab un ke oopar azaab ka wada saabit ho jaayega, hum zameen se un ke liye ek jaanwar nikaalenge jo un se baaten karta hoga ke log hamari aayaton par yaqeen nahin karte the.
ayahs.83: Aur jis din hum har ummat mein se un logon ke giroh ko jo hamari aayaton ko jhutlaate the gher-ghaar kar laayenge phir woh sab ke sab alag kar diye jaayenge.
ayahs.84: Jab sab ke sab aa pahunchenge to Allah Taala farmaayega ke tum ne meri aayaton ko ba-wujood-ye-ke tumhein un ka poora ilm na tha kyun jhutlaaya? Aur yeh bhi batlaao ke tum kya kuchh karte rahe?
ayahs.85: Ba-sabab is ke ke unhon ne zulm kiya tha un par baat jam jaayegi aur woh kuchh bol na sakenge.
ayahs.86: Kya woh dekh nahin rahe hain ke hum ne raat ko is liye banaaya hai ke woh is mein aaraam haasil kar len aur din ko hum ne dikhlaane wala banaaya hai, yaqeenan is mein un logon ke liye nishaaniyan hain jo imaan-o-yaqeen rakhte hain.
ayahs.87: Jis din soor phoonka jaayega to sab ke sab aasmanon wale aur zameen wale ghabra uthenge magar jise Allah Taala chaahe, aur saare ke saare aajiz-o-past ho kar is ke saamne haazir honge.
ayahs.88: Aur aap pahaadon ko dekh kar apni jagah jame hue khayal karte hain lekin woh bhi baadal ki tarah udte phirenge, yeh hai sanat-e-Allah ki jis ne har cheez ko mazboot banaaya hai, jo kuchh tum karte ho is se woh ba-khabar hai.
ayahs.89: Jo log nek amal laayenge unhein is se behtar badla milega aur woh is din ki ghabraahat se be-khauf honge.
ayahs.90: Aur jo buraai le kar aayenge woh aundhe munh aag mein jhonk diye jaayenge. Sirf wohi badla diye jaao ge jo tum karte rahe.
ayahs.91: Mujhe to bas yehi hukm diya gaya hai ke main is shehar ke Parwardigar ki ibaadat karta rahoon jis ne ise hurmat wala banaaya hai, jis ki milkiyat har cheez hai aur mujhe yeh bhi farmaaya gaya hai ke main farmaanbardaaron mein ho jaaoon.
ayahs.92: Aur main Quran ki tilaawat karta rahoon, jo raah-e-raast par aa jaaye woh apne nafa ke liye raah-e-raast par aayega. Aur jo behak jaaye to keh dijiye! Ke main to sirf hoshiyaar karne walon mein se hoon.
ayahs.93: Keh dijiye, ke tamaam tareefen Allah hi ko sazawaar hain woh anqareeb apni nishaaniyan dikhaayega jinhein tum (khud) pehchaan lo ge. Aur jo kuchh tum karte ho is se aap ka Rabb ghaafil nahin.
